title: Summary update under an emitted bit
statement: For every finite bit word $w$ and every optional bit $e$, updating the summary of $w$ with $e$ gives the summary of the word obtained by appending the contents of $e$ to $w$.
replaced: For every binary string $w$ and every optional bit $e$, updating the output summary of $w$ by the emission $e$ equals the output summary of $w$ with the content of $e$ appended.
